name: zone-damping-095
rationale: Second of the two interpolation points 2026-09-17's lead #1 asked for, and the conservative end of the pair. Same algebra as `zone-damping-090`: band 0.0789474/0.9210526 is slope 1.0/0.842105 = 1.1875 = x0.95 of the baseline's 1.25, i.e. a 5% amplitude reduction about neutral with no code change. The bracket measured so far (x1.00 -> 76 trades, x0.80 -> 10, x0.75 -> 1) shows the trade count collapsing far faster than the Sharpe gain accumulates, so the plausible promotable dose sits much closer to x1.00 than the midpoint; x0.95 is the point that most likely clears MIN_TRADE_COUNT_RATIO's 33-trade floor against today's 66-trade baseline while still cutting turnover. Running x0.90 and x0.95 in the same cycle turns a single sample into two more points on a curve that already has three, which is what makes the shape fittable rather than guessable. Score the cost effect on total_fees_jpy, not on trade count.
